crossRefs.note: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of…
“You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.
He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of…
When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark, and took hold of it; for the cattle…
Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
